bio: Under the aegis of Yannick Alléno, the third Pavillon Ledoyen venture is a chic restaurant with, notably, a counter to seat 32. The cuisine is built on fine classic foundations, bolstered by international flavours and details. Pitch perfect, the food is refined and delicate – to be savoured in the smart yet relaxed ambience: an excellent time is sure to be had. Gorgeous terrace surrounded by greenery....
